content: Hen anchi pés-éy sorat-o an heay Apo Teofilu, henaphapet-o hen aminay enammaan Jesus ya hen intudtuchuna nanepod hen nanginlugiyana
inggana hen namfangchana ad uchu. Yag hen anchi cha-anna namfangchan ad uchu, wacha hen impiyarna hen anchichay penepelena way aposelna way hen anchi impiyarna, narpochi hen Espiritun Apudyus.

Yag hen narpasan hen natéyana ya hen nan-uchiyana, ammag cha nampàipàila an chicha hen unig hen opatporoy ag-agaw, ya chuar agé hen tapen hen enkamanna ah manot-owaancha way nan-uchi tot-owa. Ya hen hiyachiy tempo agé, chana intudtuchu an chicha mepanggép hen mantorayan Apudyus.

Hen-argawan way nìya-among ah Jesus an chicha, intugunna way mangaliyén, “Achiayu cha lomaylayaw hen antoy fabréyanto way Jerusalem ingganah idchat Ama hen anchi imfafaggà way idchatna an chàyu way yachi hen anchi Espirituna way empopostana.
Te ah Juan, finunyagan chàyu ah chanum, ngém achi mafayagat ifunyag Apudyus hen Espirituna an chàyu way yachi hen umaliyana way mìyachar an chàyu.”
Hen émméyan Jesus ad uchu

Angkay hiyachi way kasencha na-among, inimoh hen anchichay aposel Jesus an hiya way mangaliyén, “Apo, ay faén ad uwan hen tempon hen ma-afa-an hen anchichay eRoma way chan toray an chitaaw way Judio ta egadtaaw way mangentoray hen antoy lotataaw.”
Yag sommongfat ah Jesus way mangaliyén, “Ah Amataaw way Apudyus yanggay hen nangi-ila no kamana hen umchahan hen heno way ammaana te achi mepaka-ammu cha nadchi an chàyu.

Ngém innilayu amin hen enammaà ya hen intudtuchù, wat no mìyachar hen Espiritun Apudyus an chàyu, yachi hen mangidchatana hen chakaray kafaelanyu way manàchég an haén. Wat yachi hen itudtuchuyu hen tatagu ahtod Jerusalem inggana hen aminay sakopon hen Judea ya Samaria, ya ingganah péppég hen lota.”
Angkay narpaschi way enalen Jesus yag ammag cha matarokat agé way éméy ad uchu hen nangi-il-ancha an hiya ingganah nalengfan hen funat.
Yachi way é-éttégcha way nantatangad way mangi-ila hen émméyana, ammag niyahad hen chuway anghel way nètatàchég an chicha way nanlurumfong ah pokkawan,

yag ekatchéén, “Chàyu way iGalilea, pakay an-ayug mantatangad way mangi-ila ad uchu, te ah Jesusanna way anat émméy ad uchu wat mamfangad chillu ah tapen chi ag-agaw. Te hen annay enkamanna way lommayaw, yaha agé hen ekamanna way mamfangad.”
Hen anchi neparég an Judas
Angkay hiyachi yag lommayawcha hen anchichay Aposel hen anchi filig way Olivo yag namfangadcha ad Jerusalem way ihay lometor hen ka-achawwéyna.

Yag hen inumchahancha ad Jerusalem, émméycha hen anchi kowarto way ini-inggawancha way chicha cha Pedro an cha Juan an Jaime, ah Andres, ah Felipe yah Tomas, ah Bartolome, ah Mateo yah Jaime way anà Alfeo ya anat ah Simon way ekatchéén natorod yah Judas way anà hen anchi safaliy Jaime.
Yag ammag kankanayén agé way cha mìyamoamong an chicha hen anchichay sosnod Jesus ya ah inana way Maria ya anat hen anchichay tapenay finufae way hen pontoscha amin way ma-among, ta incha manluwaru.
Angkay hen-argawan hen hiyachiy tempo way wacha ménat chi hinggasot ya chuwanporo hen anchichay na-a-among, tommàchég ah Pedro way mantudtuchu

yag ekatnéén, “Sosnod, kapeletan way tomot-owa chillu hen anchi nesosorat way alen Apudyus ad namenghan way empahpahmà hen Espiritun Apudyus an David hen nangensoratana hen mekaman an Judas way hiya hen anchi nangetnod hen anchichay nanelew an Jesus. Yag na-ammaan tot-owa amin hen anchi nesosorat,
te ah Judasanchi, hiya tot-owa hen iha an chitaaw way napele way mèamma agé hen fiyangantaaw way aposel.

Ngém annag lenyad way mangamma hen laweng ah marabfuwana paat ah pelak. Yag hen na-awni, nelao hen anchi pelakanchi ah lota, yag ahchi agé hen namfit-arana ya nàchagana way ammag finumtà hen acharna yag nifùfù amin hen fagisna.
Wat nanhemamagchi hen aminay tatagu ad Jerusalem wat ngenadnancha hen anchi lota ah Aceldama way hen laychénay aryénat ‘nachar-an way lota.’
Te nesosorat chillu ad namenghan hen anchi libnu way kankanta mepanggép an Judas, ekatnéén,

content.text: ‘Ta mapoh hen antoy tagu ya ta ammag fumaaw hen faréyna way maid inggaw.’

content: Ya hen ihay nesosorat agé, ekatnéén,

content.text: ‘Ta wacha hen meparég an hiya way mamiyang hen fiyangna.’ ”

content: Entoroy Pedro way mangaliyén, “Wat gapo ta yachi hen nesosorat, masapor man-anaptaaw ah sokat Judas ta mètape an chitaaw way manàchég hen nan-uchiyan Apo Jesus. Masapor hiya hen ihay cha netnonetnod an chitaaw hen aminay kawad-an Apo Jesus nanepod hen namunyagan Juan hen tatagu ingganah namfangchan Jesus ad uchu.”
Angkay hiyachi, imfagacha hen ngachan hen chuway larae way cha Mateo ya anat ah Jose way hen agwan hen ngachanna, ah Barsabas way manJusto.
Yachi yag anchaat manluwaru way mangaliyén, “Heay Apudyus way nangi-ila hen aminay hamhamà hen tatagu, epàilam an chàni no heno hen penepelem hen antoy chuwa
ah manokat an Judas way man-aposel te ah Judas, inyanggayana hen sa-adna yag émméy hen anchi aggaégyat way lugar way émméyana.”
Angkay narpas hen nanluwaruwancha yag namfunfunnotcha ah mangil-ancha no heno hen mapele, wat ah Mateo hen nafunotan way metape hen anchichay hemporo ya iha way aposel.
